timing: before the main S11 targeted validation; no historical campaign replay
unchanged_final_gate_exact: 3/1000000000000000 for normalization and every imposed even moment

new_diagnostic_gates.reason: This is a separate diagnostic consistency allowance for accepted nonzero lower moments and rounded normalization, not a physical moment acceptance gate. Exact ideal coefficient identities are independently checked with Fraction.
new_diagnostic_gates.C9_reference_scope: F,G,A compared with independent scalar angular integration (composite Simpson with refinement and a fourth-derivative bound); no ODE/spectral/native history

source_binding: The published rooted Git tree must match every .py/.rs/.json source/input outside evidence; the runner checks blob SHA1, full bytes, SHA256 and source commit against an external Git-readback manifest before compilation. It also checks source hashes after execution.
process_admission: Successful Rust output must be a JSON object with exit0, empty stderr, exact success status and matching order; each negative control has registered status/exit. A crash or timeout cannot pass a rejection control.
failure_retention: Unique new output directory; each actual invocation is checkpointed with raw stdin/stdout/stderr and actual exit or explicit launch/timeout classification; outer exception records never overwrite a previous run.
prepublication_review_changes: require literal boolean True birth declaration
reject duplicate directions consistently in Python and Rust; full-rank duplicate control
require exact rejection status/exit; no arbitrary-nonzero success
bind local source to published Git tree
record timeouts, launch failures and unexpected exceptions
runtime_interruption: Scratch reset destroyed unposted source and smoke receipts. Exact retained/source-published contents were restored. Original S11 math record accepted only by its original SHA256; one new math recovery execution is separately retained. Lost Rust smokes are not admitted execution evidence.
broad_admission: No continuum, full native finite-bin, reactive spectral history, full EoR, production or merge conclusion follows from these gates.
